tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search over the articles on www.mikebild.dev (software architecture, TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, Python, AI engineering) in one language (German by default, language "en" for English). Returns canonical URLs to cite.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one article as Markdown with its canonical URL, date, tags, audio link and the URLs of its other language (languages). Slugs differ per language; without language the German article is preferred.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List articles of one language (German by default, language "en" for English) newest first, optionally filtered by tag or year, plus all tags of that language with their counts.

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: List the workshop slide decks on slides.mikebild.dev with PDF, narrated video (video_url, when the deck has notes), exercise repository, related articles and slide count; languages lists every language of a deck (German, English) with its own URL, PDF and video.

tools.name: get_deck_outline
tools.description: Outline of one slide deck in German or English: every titled slide with its number, section markers and a deep link, plus PDF, video, exercise repository and related articles.

tools.name: list_workshops
tools.description: List the publicly listed workshops of workshops.mikebild.dev (title, delivery mode, topics).
